Implement an architecture-level pass for adding a DEFAULT analog on-screen steering wheel to Racing26 mobile controls. Concentrate on how wheel gesture state should flow into App.tsx and VehiclePhysicsEngine without abusing the existing binary touch steerLeft/steerRight path. Preserve analog full-rack authority while keeping keyboard speed-shaped digital steering and mouse steering behavior intact. Avoid physics/tire tuning. Evaluate whether a dedicated touchSteerInputRef and callback is cleaner than synthesizing left/right booleans, and ensure the active input mode arbitration is deterministic. Add regression coverage for sign convention (+ steering means left), center=0, clamping, input reset on menu/reset/Escape/pointer cancellation, and simultaneous steering+pedals. Produce a minimal but complete patch with exact tests.
